bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for card error message on checkout
steps_to_reproduce: Enter an invalid credit card number
Observe the error message displayed in #card-error
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Error text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background per WCAG 2.1 AA.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Error text uses color #ff9999 on a white background (#ffffff) yielding a contrast ratio of 2.04:1, which fails the required minimum.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for #card-error, change color from #ff9999 to #a36262 (4.69:1 on #ffffff; measured 2.04:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Select element #state lacks an accessible name
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to the State dropdown in the address form
Attempt to focus the dropdown using keyboard or screen reader
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The select control should have a programmatically determinable name that is announced by assistive technologies (e.g., via a visible <label>, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <select id="state"> element has no associated <label>, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, and no title attribute, resulting in no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a visible label and associate it with the select, e.g., <label for="state">State</label> before the <select>, or add aria-label="State" to the select element.
